---
title: "Drop the database through the D1 binding"
description: "Drop when the pinned release's D1 adapter drops the database without the libSQL client."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.2. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

payload migrate:fresh fails on D1 with "adapter.client.execute is not a
function", and so does starting with PAYLOAD_DROP_DATABASE=true. The D1
adapter uses the SQLite adapter's dropDatabase, which calls the libSQL
client's execute and executeMultiple. A D1 binding has neither.

The D1 adapter now has its own dropDatabase. It reads the tables from
sqlite_master, skips D1's own _cf_ tables, which D1 refuses to drop, and
drops the rest in one batch, which D1 runs as a transaction. D1 always
enforces foreign keys and ignores PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF. Dropping a table
fails with "no such table" when another table that references it also
references a table that is already dropped, so the batch drops each table
before the tables it references, read from PRAGMA foreign_key_list. It also
sets PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys, so tables that reference each other can drop
with rows in them. Each statement is DROP TABLE IF EXISTS, as in the SQLite
adapter, because dropping an FTS5 table also drops its shadow tables. The
libSQL adapter keeps the SQLite dropDatabase.

- **Patch:** `d1-drop-database`, committed as `fix(db-d1-sqlite): drop the database through the D1 binding`
- **Upstream:** [https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues/15415](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues/15415)
- **Tests:** `pnpm exec vitest run --project unit packages/db-d1-sqlite/src/dropDatabase.spec.ts; e2e suite (e2e/scripts/prepare.ts runs migrate:fresh on D1)`
